messages:
sophie (Docs): opened PR to fix two broken links + small python SDK snippet. looks trivial but blocked by CODEOWNERS requirement for /docs/sdk/ since path glob matched a sibling file
luke (Platform): ahhh the old glob overreach. we should probably special-case link-only or small tweak PRs so they don't need full owner review
sam (Eng): agreed. ops risk is low for docs typos but we still need an audit trail and an easy rollback mechanism
sophie (Docs): idea: introduce a `docs:fasttrack` label. GH action validates that the PR only touches markdown, is < 20 lines changed, and doesn't touch /docs/reference or /docs/sdk/reference. then preview-bot posts the docs preview and merge-bot can auto-merge during docs windows
luke (Platform): sounds OK but labeling needs permission constraints. also `pull_request_target` for adding labels is risky because it runs with elevated token on external PRs
sam (Eng): we should use a two-step flow: an action running on PR (normal token) that performs the diff checks and comments `Ready for fasttrack` (no write perms). then a small workflow for org members that can add the label via a protected action using `pull_request_target` only for org members
sophie (Docs): here's a rough action snippet using dorny/paths-filter for clarity:
```yaml
name: docs-fasttrack-check
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v2
        id: changes
        with:
          filters: |
            md: 'docs/**.md'
            reference: 'docs/reference/**'
      - name: count-diff-lines
        run: |
          git fetch --depth=1 origin ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          files=$(git diff --unified=0 origin/${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }} ${{ github.sha }} -- docs)
          lines=$(echo "$files" | sed -n 's/^@@.*+\([0-9]\+,[0-9]\+\).*@@/\1/p' | awk -F, '{sum+= $2} END {print sum+0}')
          echo "lines_changed=$lines" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: post result
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.changes.outputs.reference }}" != "" ]]; then
            echo "Reference files changed" && exit 1
          fi
          if [ ${{ steps.count-diff-lines.outputs.lines_changed }} -gt 20 ]; then
            echo "Too many lines" && exit 1
          fi
```

sam (Eng): nit: the sed/awk bit is brittle. maybe use git diff --numstat and sum the additions column, that's simpler
luke (Platform): also add an explicit check to block binary or non-md files and verify no `api/` YAML manifests were touched
preview-bot: preview/build queued for PR #1983: generating site snapshot...
merge-bot: note: label `docs:fasttrack` is protected. only members of team `docs-maintainers` and `release-managers` can apply it
sophie (Docs): for external contribs we still want maintainers to click a button. the action could add a comment `@docs-maintainers if this passes CI you can add docs:fasttrack to allow auto-merge`
luke (Platform): we should capture who fast-tracked (audit) and require a short reason in the label comment so we can query in GH audit logs later
sam (Eng): final thought: auto-merge should still wait for the scheduled docs merge window unless an emergency flag `docs:hotfix` is present and requires a second approver
sophie (Docs): OK I'll open an RFC/issue with the flow, add the action PR, and manually request a fast-track for my PR in the meantime. thanks all :sparkles:
